title: Enquiry From Canadian Trade Commissioners Office Respecting Present Whereabouts Of Gordon Fraser

page_data.en:
January 16 35.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt
of your letter of December 28, 1934, and to state
that no trace can be found of Gordon Fraser and it
is considered extremely unlikely that he is in
Shanghai. A Canadian aviator arrived in Shanghai
early in 1932 and applied to Colonel L.M. Cosgrave,
Canadian Trade Commissioner, for a position. Through
an introduction from Colonel Cosgrave he later met
Mr. E.A.R. Fowles of the Aviation Section of the
Asiatic Petroleum Co. and talked to him about the
possibilities of finding employment under the Chinese
Government. As Fowles was unable to hold out any
hope in this direction, the aviator did not give him
his address or any other information about himself.
It is thought that this aviator may have been Gordon
Fraser.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

〔此处转录不清〕

Commissioner of Police.

Bruce A. Macdonald, Esq.,
Acting Canadian Government
Trade Commissioner,
27 The Bund,
Shanghai.

JAS.
page_data.zh:
1935年1月16日。

先生：

谨此确认收到您1934年12月28日的来信，并告知目前查无戈登·弗雷泽（Gordon Fraser）的踪迹，且认为其身在上海的可能性极小。一名加拿大飞行员于1932年初抵达上海，并向加拿大贸易专员L.M.科斯格雷夫（L.M. Cosgrave）上校申请职位。经科斯格雷夫上校介绍，他后来会见了亚细亚火油公司（Asiatic Petroleum Co.）航空部的E.A.R.福尔斯（E.A.R. Fowles）先生，并与之探讨了在中国政府麾下就业的可能性。由于福尔斯先生无法在此方面提供任何希望，该飞行员未向其留下地址或关于自身的其他信息。据信这名飞行员可能就是戈登·弗雷泽。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

〔此处转录不清〕

警务处处长。

致布鲁斯·A·麦克唐纳（Bruce A. Macdonald）先生，
加拿大政府代理贸易专员，
上海外滩27号。

JAS.

Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by: [Signature]

MR. JONES, who was interviewed today by me at Police
Station, stated that he was in Shanghai early in
1932. He could not remember the man's description as at
that time there were about thirty five aviators in Shanghai
who were seeking jobs with the Chinese Government, and
most of these approached him at one time or other for
assistance.

主题：琼斯先生，加拿大籍上尉。佩奇少校提及来自美国空军的招募飞行员事宜。
由 D.S. 琼斯呈报 转呈人：[签名]

琼斯先生今日在警察局接受本人问询时称，他于1932年初身在上海。他已记不起那人的体貌特征，因为当时上海约有三十名飞行员正在寻求为中国政府工作，其中大多数人曾先后向他求助。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S.B. REGISTRY. 6362
Special Branch. D____ Station,
REPORT
Date. ____ 1/__/__ 19____
Subject Enquiry from Canadian Trade Commissioner's Office respecting
present whereabouts of one Gordon Fraser.
Made by D.C. (S.B.) Forwarded by D.B.Rm D.I.

With reference to the remarks of D.J. Special Branch
on the attached report dated January 7 of D.J.. Holder
regarding one Gordon Fraser, I have to state that there is
nobody in the Canadian Trade Commissioner's office able to
furnish any additional information about him.

In January 1932 the undermentioned Canadians came to
Shanghai in the expectation of securing appointments in the
Chinese Air Force :
A.E. Geary, J. Hansen, Gordon Sulger, Charles Doyle,
J. Evans, Pierre Flamant.

None was successful in finding employment with the
Chinese and on February 7, 1932, Sulger, Doyle, Evans and
Flamant were repatriated on the S.S. Empress of Asia.

Geary and Hansen, however, found jobs in Shanghai and
are still here. I got into touch with both these men and
questioned them about Fraser. Neither knew anything about him
and Hansen stated that no-one of that name came over with
their party from Canada.

It has been impossible to obtain any information about
Fraser from local travel and shipping agencies.

In view of the exhaustive efforts made to trace this
individual and the lack of success attending these efforts, I
consider it extremely unlikely that Fraser is still in this
city.

C.H. Jones
D.S.

D.C. (Special Branch) S2,
To Mr Fowles care of
Gordon Fraser's name and does he
remember his description &
D.S. Jones D.S.B. 1571
JAN. 15 1935

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 S.B. REGISTRY. 6362
特务科。D____ 分局，
报告
日期：____ 1/__/__ 19____
主题：加拿大贸易专员办事处查询戈登·弗雷泽一人之下落。
由 D.C. (S.B.) 制作 转呈人 D.B.Rm D.I.

关于附件中1月7日特务科 D.J. 霍尔德（Holder）就戈登·弗雷泽一人所作出的备注，本人须说明，加拿大贸易专员办事处内无人能提供更多关于他的信息。

1932年1月，下列加拿大人来到上海，期望在中国空军获得职位：
A.E. 格里（Geary）、J. 汉森（Hansen）、戈登·萨格（Gordon Sulger）、查尔斯·多伊尔（Charles Doyle）、
J. 埃文斯（Evans）、皮埃尔·弗拉芒（Pierre Flamant）。

无人成功受雇于中方，1932年2月7日，萨格、多伊尔、埃文斯和弗拉芒乘“亚洲皇后”号轮船（S.S. Empress of Asia）被遣返。

然而，格里和汉森在上海找到了工作，至今仍在此地。本人与这两人均取得了联系，并就弗雷泽一事向他们询问。两人均对他一无所知，汉森并称，从加拿大与他们同行的人员中并无叫此名字者。

未能从本地旅行社及航运代理机构处获得任何关于弗雷泽的信息。

鉴于为追踪此人已竭尽全力却未果，本人认为弗雷泽仍在本市的可能性极小。

C.H. 琼斯
D.S.

特务科副警务处长 S2，
致福尔斯先生，由
戈登·弗雷泽之名转交，他是否记得其体貌特征 &
D.S. 琼斯 D.S.B. 1571

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. R.6312.
S. 2, Special Branch. XXXXX
REPORT
Date January 7, 19 35.

Subject Reference the attached correspondence relative to one
Gordon Fraser, Canadian.

Made by D.S.I. Golder. Forwarded by [Signature]

The only information coming to hand regarding the
subject of the attached correspondence is that during the Sino-
Japanese hostilities of 1932 he arrived in Shanghai together
with a group of aviators and applied to Colonel Cosgrave,
Canadian Government Trade Commissioner for China for a position.
Colonel Cosgrave referred him to E.A.R. Fowles of the Aviation
Section of the Asiatic Petroleum Company. Fraser approached
Fowles one morning and asked whether it would be possible
to obtain a post under the Chinese Government but was informed
that very little could be done in that direction. Mr. Fowles
took Fraser to the Royal Air Force Club in the Hongkong Shanghai
Bank and gave him tiffin and since that time has not seen him.
Fraser left no address nor offered any information as to his
immediate intentions.

Exhaustive enquiries have been made at all hotels,
aviation companies, charitable institutions, clubs and boarding
houses but no further information has so far come to hand.
The H.B.M. Consulate have no record of the man beyond certain
correspondence similar to that attached, nor is there any
reference contained in the files of C.S. 2 or the French
Boarding House Section.

[Signature]
D.S. Jones.
Inspector.
[Signature]
Em Golder
D. S. I.
DAR 8/1.

D. C. (Special Branch).
S.2.

Does anyone in the Canadian Trade
Commissioner's Office remember anything about him or
any other members of the group of aviators with whom
he came & where what ship did they travel & do local
travel and shipping agencies know anything about Fraser? G.H.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 R.6312.
S. 2, 特务科。XXXXX
报告
日期：1935年1月7日。

主题：关于附件中涉及加拿大人戈登·弗雷泽的往来信函。

由 D.S.I. 戈尔德（Golder）制作。转呈人 [签名]

关于附件信函主题，目前掌握的唯一信息是：在1932年中日冲突期间，他与一群飞行员一同抵达上海，并向加拿大政府驻华贸易专员科斯格雷夫（Cosgrave）上校申请职位。科斯格雷夫上校将其引荐给亚细亚火油公司航空部的E.A.R.福尔斯（Fowles）。弗雷泽某日上午拜访福尔斯，询问是否可能在中国政府下获得职位，但被告知在此方面能做的非常有限。福尔斯先生带弗雷泽前往汇丰银行内的皇家空军俱乐部，请他吃了便餐，自那以后便再未见过他。弗雷泽未留下地址，也未透露其近期打算的任何信息。

已向所有旅馆、航空公司、慈善机构、俱乐部及寄宿公寓进行了详尽查询，但迄今未获进一步信息。英国领事馆除了一些类似附件中的往来信函外，并无此人的记录；中央巡捕房2处（C.S. 2）或法租界寄宿公寓组的档案中亦无任何相关记载。

[签名]
D.S. 琼斯。
督察。
[签名]
Em 戈尔德
D. S. I.
DAR 8/1.

特务科副警务处长。
S.2.

加拿大贸易专员办事处是否有人记得关于他或与他同来的那群飞行员中其他成员的任何情况？他们乘坐哪艘船而来？本地旅行社和航运代理机构是否了解有关弗雷泽的情况？ G.H.

FROM: H.E. The Hon. Herbert Marler, Canadian Legation,
Tokyo, Japan.

TO: H.E. Mr. Koki Hirota, H.I.J.M. Minister for Foreign
Affairs, Tokyo, Japan.

Excellency:

December 14th, 1934.

I have the honour to inform you that in response
to enquiries from Canada I am endeavouring to ascertain
the present domicile of one Gordon Fraser, a Canadian national
and the son of Mrs. David Fraser of Lancaster, Ontario, Canada.
Mr. Fraser was last heard of four years ago, but he is rumoured
to have left Canada for Japan or China. As an ex-member of
the Royal Air Force it is supposed that he may have become
connected with aviation activities in the country of his present
residence. Mr. Fraser's personal description is as follows:

Age 40; hair, light brown turning grey; eyes, blue-grey,
height, 5ft. 10½ ins.

If the files of your police or immigration authorities
contain any record of Mr. Fraser's arrival in Japan I shall be
most grateful if you will allow me to examine the information
that they contain. For any assistance whatever I shall be most
grateful.

Accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest
consideration.

Yours faithfully,
page_data.zh:
副本

发件人：赫伯特·马勒（Herbert Marler）阁下，加拿大驻日本公使馆，
日本东京。

收件人：广田弘毅（Koki Hirota）先生阁下，日本帝国
外交大臣，日本东京。

阁下：

1934年12月14日。

谨此奉告，应加拿大方面的查询，我正努力查明加拿大国民戈登·弗雷泽目前的居住地，他是加拿大安大略省兰开斯特（Lancaster）的大卫·弗雷泽（David Fraser）夫人的儿子。四年前曾有关于弗雷泽先生的最后消息，但有传言称他已离开加拿大前往日本或中国。作为前皇家空军成员，据推测他可能已与其现居住国的航空活动产生关联。弗雷泽先生的个人体貌特征如下：

年龄40岁；头发，浅棕色渐灰；眼睛，蓝灰色，
身高，5英尺10.5英寸。

若贵国警察或移民当局的档案中存有弗雷泽先生抵达日本的任何记录，若能允许我查阅其中包含的信息，我将不胜感激。对于任何形式的协助，我都将深表感谢。

阁下，请接受我最崇高的敬意。

您忠实的，

page_data.en:
FROM: Canadian Legation, Tokyo
TO: Canadian Govt.Trade Commissioner, Shanghai.

December 14, 1934.

Dear Mr. Macdonald:

I am enclosing herewith a copy of a letter
that I have today addressed to the Minister for Foreign
Affairs of the Imperial Japanese Government with regard
to a Mr. Gordon Fraser whose mother in Canada is trying to
ascertain his present whereabouts. As you will see from
the copy of Mrs. Fraser's letter which is also enclosed,
there is some possibility that Mr. Fraser may have gone to
China. I shall be very much obliged if you will take the
matter up with the local authorities in Shanghai and endeavour
to ascertain whether or not they can supply any useful infor-
mation. I am asking Major Duclos to do the same in Hongkong
and Mr. Bissette in Tientsin.

Yours sincerely,

( H. Marler)

亲爱的麦克唐纳先生：

随函附上我今天致日本帝国政府外交大臣的一封信的副本，内容是关于戈登·弗雷泽先生，其在加拿大的母亲正试图查明他目前的下落。从随附的弗雷泽夫人信件副本中您可以看出，弗雷泽先生有可能去了中国。若您能与上海当地当局交涉，并尽力查明他们能否提供有用的信息，我将不胜感激。我已要求杜克洛（Duclos）少校在香港进行同样的查询，并要求比塞特（Bissette）先生在天津进行同样的查询。

您诚挚的，

( H. 马勒)

page_data.en:
COPY

FROM: Mrs. David Fraser
TO: The Hon. Herbert Marler, Tokyo.

November 15, 1934.

Dear Mr. Marler:

You very kindly said you would have enquiries made
for my son Gordon Fraser who disappeared from Calgary in
August 1930.

The only word I have had of him is the rumour that
he was serving in the Air Force in either Japan or China. He
was in the R.A.F. at the end of the War, so there may be some
truth in it.

I have been unable to obtain a later photograph than
the one I enclose and, of course, he will look much older now.
He will be 40 this month, light hair turned Brown and (I expect
getting grey), blue grey eyes and is about 5ft. 10½ inc. tall.

I am afraid this search will be a forlorn hope, but
I shall be most grateful for your help. I hope you are feeling
quite well again.

Yours sincerely,

Harriet Fraser
(Mrs. David Fraser)
page_data.zh:
副本

发件人：大卫·弗雷泽夫人
收件人：赫伯特·马勒阁下，东京。

1934年11月15日。

亲爱的马勒先生：

您曾好心地表示会为我于1930年8月在卡尔加里失踪的儿子戈登·弗雷泽进行查询。

关于他的唯一消息是传言他在日本或中国的空军服役。他在战争结束时曾在皇家空军（R.A.F.）服役，因此这可能确有其事。

我未能获得比我随函附上的照片更近的照片，当然，他现在看起来会老得多。他本月将满40岁，浅色头发变为棕色（我想正在变灰），蓝灰色眼睛，身高约5英尺10.5英寸。

恐怕这次寻找将是徒劳的希望，但我对您的帮助将深表感激。希望您身体已完全康复。

您诚挚的，

哈丽特·弗雷泽
（大卫·弗雷泽夫人）

December l4th, 1934. 


I have the honour to inform you that in response 
to enguiries from Canada I am endeavouring to ascertain 
the present domicile of one Gordon Fraser, a Canadian national 
and the son of Mrs. David Fraser of Lancaster, Ontario, Canada. 
Mr. Fraser was last heard of four years ago, but he is rumoured 
to have left Canada for Japan or China. As an ex-member of 
the Royal Air Foree it is supposed that he may have become 
connected with aviation activities in the country of his present 
residence. Mr. Fraser's personal description is as follows: 


Age 40; hair, light brown turning grey; eyes, blue-grey, 
height, Sft. 10% ins.

contain reoord of Mr. Fraser's arrival in Japan I shall be 
most te: if you will allow me to examine the information 
that they contain. For any assistance whatever I shall be most 


grateful.

December 14, 1934. 


Dear Mr. Mavdunald: 


I am enclosing herewith a oopy of a letter 
that I have today addressed to the Minister for Foreign 
Affairs of the Imperial Japanese Government with regard 
to a Mr. Gordon Fraser whose mother in Canada is trying to 
asoertain his present whereabouts. As you will see from 
the copy of Mrs. Fraser's letter which is also enolosed, 
there is some possibility that Mr. Fraser may have gone to 
China. I shall be very much obliged if you will take the 
matter up with the local authorities in Shanghai and endeavour 
to ascertain whether or not they can supply any useful infor- 
mation. I am asking Major Duclos to do the same in Hongkong 
and Mr. Bissette in 7ientsin. 


Yours sincerely,

TO: The Hon. Herbert Marler, Tokyo. 


November 15, 19324. 


Dear Mr. Marler: 


You very kindly said you would have enquiries made 
for my son Gordon Fraser who disappeared from Calgary in 
August 1930. 


The only word I have had of him is the rumour that 
he was serving in the Air Force in either Japan or China. Ie 
was in the R.A-F. at the end of the War, so there may be some 
truth in it. 


I have been unable to obtain a later photograph than 
the one I enclose and, of course, he will look much older now. 
He will be 40 this month, light hair turned Brown and (I expect 
getting grey), blue grey eyes and is about Sft. 10% inc. tall. 


I am afraid this searoh will v2 a forlorn hom, but 


I shall be most grateful for your help. I hope you are feeling 
quite well again. 


Yours sinoerely, 


Harriet Fraser
